Inside the studio

We come from different parts of the world and share a studio in Los Angeles. We’re a small team by design. It gives us time to work through the details together, from the first sketch to the finish on a prototype.

We like working in person. Put a sketch on the table and someone who sees it differently can pick up a pencil and show you why. That exchange shapes what we make. We want people using our computers to have the same freedom to look up, share an idea, and keep working together.
